sentences: My old dog walks slowly up the green hill.
I spread sweet honey on my warm fresh bread.
I went out to play though it looked like it was going to rain.

When I am in bed, I hear the sounds outside the room. The wind sings and I feel so sleepy. Mum reads to herself in the next room. Dad plays a soft song to himself too. In an instant, my eyes begin to close. Such soft sounds carry me to my dreams.

A new girl joined our class from a foreign country. She had a warm smile and hair that was longer than mine. We discussed our history and culture at lunch. She taught me new words, and I taught her some too. We expressed our ideas and made up a secret hand sign. We will be great friends for years to come.
My parents went to school for the big meeting.
Spring is the best season of the whole year.
We drink cool water from the clear little stream.

Our class went on a nature search in a wild region near our town. We walked beside a stream to find its source. The current ran strong and cold at the top. I brought a book to draw all that I saw. We found more than thirty kinds of plants and birds along the way. I looked at each one with care and did my best to draw it. The trip felt great because it involved so much learning.

On clear nights, Dad and I observe the stars in nature. We collect facts about each one we can name. I connect the bright spots to make a shape in the sky. I compare the big stars to the small ones. Dad helps me measure how far one sits from the next. We count a huge number of them, but never all! If I miss one, Dad helps me correct my list. I wonder how long their light must travel to reach us. Perhaps one day, I will fly up to see them close!"
My sister made the pink cake all by herself.
I came in second place in the running race.
I draw a picture of my brown dog for grandma.

There was a race in school today. Every child came ready to run and jump. My whole family stood by the track to cheer. I took a deep breath and ran my fastest. I made a new school record! My teacher gave me a shiny silver cup and my father took a picture. I am already looking forward to next year. Nothing can stop me now!

I wrote a card to my grandma today. I told her how I got second place in the spelling test. I drew a funny face in the middle of the card. I posted the card to grandma all by myself. I wonder what grandma will think the moment she gets it. Maybe she will notice how much my writing has improved.
Please wait here for a moment while I get my bag.
The days grow longer in the middle of the summer.
Nobody was home so I played with my dog outside.

Last year, we went on a trip to see winter for the first time! From our window, I watched the white snow cover the whole street. The trees looked quiet and the world seemed still. My mother made warm milk for us. We would listen to music in the living room. My brother read a chapter of his book. Winter is a lovely season to spend with family. I would not change a single thing!

My teacher asked me to give a speech in English class. I chose to talk about the natural world. I looked at my notes once, then spoke slowly and clearly. I used an example about a river and a spring. The whole class heard me, and nobody made a sound. My method was simple. I spoke from the heart, believed in myself, and stood tall. It went so well that I felt proud. I would love to give speeches again.
I would love to visit a foreign country one day.
It is natural for birds to fly south in winter.
My brother built the model boat all by himself.

Our class holds a council once a month, and it is run by us. Every child has a voice and the same rights within the group. This month, we have a reason to meet, as our book box is always in a mess. We make a new policy to keep it in good order. I come up with a simple scheme to sort each public book by size. The class likes it, so my plan will remain for now. In just a few minutes, we all agree. Please put each book back, our sign now says.

Our class planted a young tree in the school yard. Trees give us the oxygen we need, so they help our whole planet. My teacher told us the theory that trees can cool a street. I relate to that, because I love to rest under a cool green tree! We water it daily, and we are certain it will grow tall. I cannot wait to return each day and see how big it gets. Let us all do more to show our concern for planet Earth.
The kind officer helped me cross the busy street.
My dad knows how to operate the big machine.
The soft brown rabbit hops around in the garden.

It was a warm day out at the sea. Many families came to swim and play. There must have been around a hundred people. My father and I took our biggest jump off the rocks. On my first attempt, I made a sudden, huge splash! The water spread out in a wide pattern and flew towards my mother. It caught her square on the back, and she got all wet. She laughed and pulled her hat down. Between each jump, we swam out a bit further. However tired we were, we went back for another minute of fun. Finally, we said goodbye to the sea and walked home.

Next to our kitchen, we have a modern washing machine. It cleans my coat while I finish my work. Life was not the same a century ago, they say. Families had to wash every coat in the river! Machines like this improve our lives in a million ways. I am so glad for the simple things at home. Instead of hard work, we now have more time to play. Every member of my family feels lucky!
We travel to the sea by train every year.
We spend the evening in the living room.
The opposing team is strong in their defence.

Every week, my mum and I visit the local market in the morning. People sell fresh bread, warm cookies and sweet apples. I carry the basket and help choose the best orange. My little sister picks a pretty flower for my grandpa. A kind person gives us an extra apple for free! On the way home, we hear the birds sing. I really love spending time with my family. It is the perfect start to the week!

Every summer, our garden is full of colour. Purple and gold flowers grow along the low wall. A rabbit hops across the grass every evening. Mum's system is simple. She waters each plant in the right order so the plants always grow well. I follow her around like a happy helper. Our happy garden makes the whole road smile!
We finally arrived at the sea after the long trip.
I select the biggest red apple from the basket.
I know I should water the plants every morning.

Our band will perform in the parade this year. I manage the beat while my friend plays the melody, and we set the whole street in motion. A police officer smiles at us from her office door as we march past. Families from all over the nation come to watch a parade like this. Mr Ray gives the big bell a strike right on time. We play for one full period, and no matter how long we go, no one wants such fun to end.

On a recent trip, we visited a farm just past our town. The farmers let us watch them operate their machines, with wheels taller than me! They grow a huge supply of corn and keep cows for milk. A company buys all they can grow and ships it far away, even to America. In this way, the farm helps our whole economy. The farmers also educate us about how to care for the land. I never knew that one small farm could feed so many people!
